bio.text: James "Rus" Russell is the Democratic nominee for Arkansas's 4th Congressional District in 2026, having won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.

According to his campaign website, he was born in Bossier City, Louisiana, and he and his wife have owned and operated an outpatient mental health business in Little Rock since 2014; Ballotpedia says he has lived in Little Rock.

Ballotpedia lists a B.S. in philosophy from the University of Central Arkansas in 2012 and service in the U.S. Army National Guard in 1996; his campaign website says he enlisted in the Arkansas National Guard.
